description: This file demonstrates basic Spark SQL features using PySpark, including DataFrame creation, schema inference, programmatic schema, and SQL queries.

classes.name: SparkSession
classes.description: Main entry point for DataFrame and SQL functionality in PySpark.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Class used to create row objects for DataFrames.

classes.name: StructType
classes.description: Defines the schema of a DataFrame with a list of StructField objects.

classes.name: StructField
classes.description: Defines a single field in a StructType schema.

methods.name: basic_df_example
methods.description: Demonstrates creating a DataFrame from a JSON file, inspecting schema, selecting columns, filtering, grouping, and executing SQL queries.

methods.name: schema_inference_example
methods.description: Shows schema inference from a text file and executing SQL queries on the inferred schema.

methods.name: programmatic_schema_example
methods.description: Creates a schema programmatically, applies it to data, and runs SQL queries.
